issues.defect: Boundedness of the source is used without being assumed. For a literal counterexample take two bases 0,1, own fiber K_0=[−1,1]^3 with Y=0, and K_1={(x,y,r):0≤x≤1, |y|≥1, 0≤r≤|y|^{−3}}. The old caps ±x−4z≥0 have mass Q=4 and balance; any containing cap keeps at least half the centrally symmetric own cube. Use the perturbed margins ±x−4z+sy. Near (0,0) the own contribution is 4(1−c), while the remote contribution is s²/2 times ∫_0^1(4+c∓x)^{−2} dx, a smooth function. For the plus-x cap A=1/12>0, but at s=0 all nearby remote sections are empty and the own second section moment is 4/3, constant in c. Thus the claimed section derivative would give A=0.
